The estimate rests on a PitchBook figure of 17 total employees and the firm's own statement that it is heading toward 20. Its listed hours are Tuesday and Wednesday only, so I put the weekday figure below the total.

A person should check whether the registration 57 m away is this firm. Its registered address appears to be Danziger Str. 27.
